diagnosis: Customer asks how to reset an API token for an ETL job. Unified Auth accounts use scoped keys; procedure is create replacement, migrate traffic, revoke old key. Note kb-0018: credential changes require confirmation from a named account owner.
reply: Thanks for reaching out. Accounts on Unified Auth manage credentials as scoped keys rather than one account-wide credential. The recommended procedure is: create a replacement key with the scopes you need, move your ETL traffic onto it, and then revoke the previous key. Please note there is no grace period — revocation is immediate — and a key's scopes cannot be widened after creation, so make sure your new key has all the necessary scopes before you switch over. Also, requests that change credentials require confirmation from a named account owner on record.
